title: TopologyOverlayLayer
description: Materialized topology overlay layer applied on top of a base artifact graph.

id.description: Stable id for upsert and removal. Recommended shape: chat:<kind>:<target>:<qualifier>.

label.description: Short label for UI layer controls.

priority.description: Render conflict ordering. Higher priority applies later.

visible.description: Whether the layer should currently be rendered.

targets.description: Topology graph elements affected by the layer.

effects.description: Existing topology view patch effect vocabulary to apply for this layer.

graphOverlay.description: Bounded graph overlay when this layer represents a drilldown.

runtime.description: Optional runtime metadata for metric/state layers.

relationship.description: Optional typed metadata for layers produced from callable topology relationships.

save.description: Optional save/template metadata used when extracting durable custom topology views.

meta.description: Implementation-defined source, confidence, match, run, and diagnostic metadata.
